description: This file defines the `MethodSourcer` class, which extends `MethodVisitor` from the ASM library. It generates Java source code representations for Java methods by processing bytecode elements, signatures, annotations, and other method-related components. The class is part of a tool that creates stub source code for Android build processes.

classes.name: MethodSourcer
classes.description: A class that extends ASM's `MethodVisitor` to generate Java source code for methods, including signature processing, annotations, and method declarations.

methods.name: MethodSourcer
methods.description: Constructor initializing `MethodSourcer` with method metadata and output configuration.

methods.name: writeHeader
methods.description: Generates the method signature, including access modifiers, return type, name, parameters, exceptions, and opening brace.

methods.name: visitCode
methods.description: Writes the method stub body, which currently throws a RuntimeException.

methods.name: visitEnd
methods.description: Finalizes the method source code block, closing the method with a curly brace.

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Handles method annotations, writes their descriptor, and returns an `AnnotationSourcer`.
